from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CashBalance(BaseModel):
    """A cash balance line item extracted from a single company's financial document."""
    company_name: str = Field(description="The name of the company or trust the document belongs to")
    line_item_label: str = Field(description="The exact label of the cash line item as written in the document")
    reported_amount: float = Field(description="The numerical value of the cash balance as extracted from the text")
    unit_scale: str = Field(description="The scale of the reported amount, e.g., 'thousands', 'millions', or 'dollars'")
    reporting_period_end: str = Field(description="The date as of which this balance is reported")
    text_evidence: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt containing the value and context")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cash_balances: list[CashBalance]
